comment: save.c dosave0() reads each other level back and writes it again with savelev(), whose timestamp is svm.moves at the save (save.c:512-513), not the turn the hero left it. The first segment builds Dlvl 6, leaves it for Dlvl 2, searches there and saves. After the restore, ^V6 returns at once, so getlev() finds no elapsed time: restore.c 1211-1220 skips mon_catchup_elapsed_time() and the rnd(10) hiding test for every monster, and the next call is u_on_rndspot()'s place_lregion().
